evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 3. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded six-year profile, senior rigor and regulator-aligned simulated-attack work support expert assessment responsibility; UK recognition is credible but does not establish Japanese workforce equivalence.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded regulator recognition, senior rigor and a six-year profile support expert simulated-attack work in demanding assurance engagements. The evidence describes a specialist operator exam without detailed practical logistics, so live red-team performance still warrants validation.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded six-year profile and senior simulated-attack scope, with CBEST and STAR alignment, support expert offensive consulting responsibility. I rely on that recorded regulated-assurance context rather than assume an unrecorded exam duration.
